spec_features.spec_quote: turn budget high enough to let the spiral form (default 30) but capped to control cost
spec_features.evidence: config.py:46 `max_turns: int = 30`; harness.py:186 `for _turn in range(self.config.max_turns):` and the for/else at harness.py:250-251 sets `ts.end_reason = "turn_budget"`, ending the loop. The cap is read and bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: loop iterates at most max_turns and terminates.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: "Defaults are tuned to be cheap while still giving the spiral room to develop."

spec_features.feature_name: termination on finish / turn budget / degeneracy guard
spec_features.spec_quote: Terminate on: `finish`, turn budget exhausted, or **degeneracy guard**
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:239-242 finish breaks loop (end_reason=finish); harness.py:250-251 turn_budget via for/else; degeneracy guard fires at harness.py:204-207 (near-dup via _is_degenerate, lines 269-278 compare normalized_similarity to degeneracy_repeat_threshold) and at lines 221-222 / 228-229 (empty_streak >= degeneracy_empty_window). All three actually break the loop and set end_reason.
spec_features.notes: All three termination conditions are wired, checked, and break execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:10-11 "A degeneracy guard ends the run early once collapse is obvious ... to cap cost"; harness.py docstring/comment "end early once collapse is obvious to save tokens"

spec_features.evidence: Advertised in TOOLS_DOC (harness.py:43) AND honored: harness.py:239-242 `if name == "finish": ... ts.end_reason = "finish"; break`. It is a special-cased stop, not merely dispatched.
spec_features.notes: Tool is recognized and acted on as a real stop. Note _dispatch (lines 145-154) has no 'finish' handler precisely because finish is handled before dispatch as a break.

spec_features.spec_quote: Malformed calls get a gentle reparse-nudge once, then count as a wasted turn
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:210-231: when parse_tool_call returns None and `not already_nudged`, a nudge user message is appended (lines 213-218) and already_nudged set True; subsequent malformed turns skip the nudge and increment empty_streak as wasted turns (lines 226-231). The nudge is constructed and delivered to the subject exactly once.
spec_features.notes: Both the once-only nudge and the subsequent wasted-turn counting are implemented and executed.
